verdict.rationale: Kino's own docs say the desktop app runs an MCP server. They name ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor as clients that can search footage and edit projects from their own chat, so a first-party MCP server is documented directly. That support rests on a single sentence, and the community posts discuss Claude Code but not connecting it through Kino's MCP server. Missing for 10: MCP setup/connection docs, exposed tool list, auth/transport details, independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The desktop app runs an MCP server, so ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can search your footage and edit your projects from their own chat.
